task_body_references.description:
- **Pull request:** https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/2836
- **Exact head:** b1c18fdb1b9e90d4532402e5fd0583f5f9dc7026 — bind the verdict to this sha and re-check it is still current at the moment you post
- **Files:** detcore/src/scheduler.rs, the SaBRe backend reporting path, hermit-cli/tests/sabre_examples.rs
- **Action:** independent adversarial review, then post the verdict on the pull request and record the comment permalink back on this task
- **Why:** the change alters when core Detcore scheduling incorporates an asynchronously reported physical process exit. The implementor flagged it for post-facto human review itself, and the core-change protocol requires a review round it cannot supply for its own work.
- **Verify:** a verdict posted on the pull request with the permalink recorded here

**What the change does.** A host-side race: the SaBRe reaper could report a final child exit before or after the scheduler reached its empty-queue shutdown check, so the shutdown INFO sequence varied at guest width 20 and matched at width 8. The fix moves the barrier release off the host-driven call — the reaper reports, and the scheduler applies at its next loop-top maintenance point — so host timing no longer decides the ordering.
